references.text: Jesus explains that Lazarus' illness will not lead to death, but will serve to glorify God, paralleling the explanation in John 9:3 that blindness exists so that God's works may be revealed.
Jesus states that He has completed God's works on earth, connecting to the theme in John 9:3 that God's works are to be revealed through human situations.
God's purpose in creating and forming humanity is for the sake of His glory, a theme reflected in Jesus' words that the blind man was born so that God's works might be revealed in him.
